use IO.Std.write_line

class ACCOUNT(owner: string) is
    _balance: int

    deposit(amount: int) is
        assert amount > 0 else "a deposit must be positive"

        _balance = _balance + amount
    si

    balance: int => _balance

    to_string() -> string => "{owner} has {_balance}"
si

let account = ACCOUNT("alice")

account.deposit(30)
account.deposit(12)

write_line("{account}")
write_line("balance read through the property: {account.balance}")
output:
alice has 42
balance read through the property: 42
